formats.key: submitRun(uint256 score, uint256 level, bytes32 runId, uint256 nonce, bytes sig)
effects: Mints one new BureaucrawlRuns NFT (next token id) to the signer; it cannot be transferred (soulbound), only burned.
Records score, level, runId and the block timestamp for that token, raises the signer's runCount by one and updates the signer's bestScore if this score is higher.
Uses up the runId and the (runId, nonce) pair so they cannot be minted again; the call reverts unless scoreSigner signed (signer, score, level, runId, nonce).
Not payable: no ETH or tokens leave the signer.
formats.shown: Mint run, score N, with fields for score, level and run ID; the nonce and signature are hidden.

findings.title: submitRun intent does not say the minted run NFT is soulbound and cannot be transferred.
findings.evidence: BureaucrawlRuns.flat.sol _update: `if (from != address(0) && to != address(0)) revert Soulbound();`; descriptor intent "Mint Bureaucrawl run".
findings.fix: Optionally say "Mint soulbound Bureaucrawl run NFT" in the intent.

effects: Owner only: replaces the base URI used for tokenURI of every BureaucrawlRuns NFT. No assets move.
formats.shown: Set base URI to the given string, shown as a field too.

effects: Owner only: replaces scoreSigner, the key whose EIP-712 signatures authorize run mints. Payloads signed by the old key stop working at once. Reverts on the zero address. No assets move.
formats.shown: Rotate score signer key to the named address.

effects: Owner only: sets pendingOwner to newOwner and replaces any earlier pending transfer. Ownership moves only when newOwner calls acceptOwnership. If newOwner is the zero address, this cancels the pending transfer.
formats.shown: Propose new owner at the given address.

findings.title: transferOwnership to the zero address cancels a pending transfer; the screen shows only the literal address.
findings.evidence: Ownable2Step.transferOwnership: `_pendingOwner = newOwner;` and the doc comment "Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer." The descriptor field 'New owner' has no special case for 0x0.
findings.fix: Optionally add a label or note that the zero address cancels the pending transfer.

effects: The pending owner (the signer) becomes owner of the contract and gains control of setSigner, setBaseURI, transferOwnership and renounceOwnership. pendingOwner is cleared.
Owner only: sets owner to the zero address and clears pendingOwner. Nobody can ever again call setSigner or setBaseURI, or transfer ownership.
